name: Beth Shemesh
overview: Beth Shemesh is depicted in Scripture as a significant city situated on the northern border of Judah's territory, as outlined in Joshua 15:10, and also appears within the tribal allocations of Dan and Naphtali (Joshua 19:22, 19:38). It was a Levitical city with priestly functions, evidenced by its inclusion among cities given to the priests (Joshua 21:16). Despite its importance, Judges 1:33 records that the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh were not driven out by Naphtali and instead became tributaries, highlighting the ongoing struggles Israel faced in fully possessing the land.
